title: Rainbow system (Plains)
dek: Rainbow Light crude gathered in the Rainbow Lake country moves south on Rainbow I to Edmonton, where it enters the MSW pool as Rainbow Light (RA). The Norman Wells feed that anchored the north end shut in August 2026 and is drawn as history. How the system's Peace River and Wabasca heavy feeds are tendered at Edmonton today is an open item: it is printed as one, never drawn as a route.
